protectedInterfaceOriginal: Oracle does not track Weave Dissonance. Revelation Charges, the permanent Curse, and Prophecy Triggers are the Oracle's anti-spam architecture.
engine: PROVISIONAL PLAYTEST CONTRACT. Charisma is the Oracle class ability. S = 1/2/3/4 at Oracle levels 1/5/11/17. M = max(1, Charisma modifier). Revelation attack = d20 + normal character proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier. Revelation save DC = 8 + normal character proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier.

HIT DIE CONFLICT. The class overview registry lists d8, while the detailed Player Rulebook Oracle entry states 6 + Constitution modifier at level 1 and d6 per Oracle level thereafter. This pilot uses the detailed rulebook d6 chassis: 6 + Constitution modifier at Oracle 1 and 1d6 per later Oracle level. The d8 registry value remains a preserved alternative pending owner adjudication.

The Oracle is an exceptional progression class rather than a 25-choice Base/Arch/Hero class. Base Oracle is levels 1-2, Revelation Tier development is the Arch-stage progression at levels 3-9, and Revelation Mastery is the Hero-stage progression at levels 10-20. Mystery and Curse are chosen at level 1 but their later Revelations, Boons and Final abilities remain class-level gated.

Choose exactly ONE Mystery and exactly ONE Curse at Oracle level 1. They are not parallel subclasses that stack. You never gain another Mystery or Curse unless a future explicit retraining or transformation rule says otherwise. Curse limitations are permanent and cannot be removed by ordinary cleansing, curse removal, resurrection or rest.

REVELATION CHARGES are the Oracle's only class power resource. Oracles do not use Resonance Points, spell slots, Weave Dissonance, Overcast or ordinary spell-rank casting for Revelations. Revelation Charges are abbreviated RC. A Revelation card's printed RC cost is paid once before resolution. An illegal activation spends nothing.

RC CAP SCHEDULE for this provisional module: maximum 3 at Oracle levels 1-2, 4 at levels 3-5, 5 at levels 6-8, 6 at levels 9-10 and 7 at level 11+. Increasing the maximum does not automatically refill spent charges except where another feature explicitly says so.

RC RECOVERY. A completed long rest restores RC to maximum. A completed short rest restores 1 spent RC, never above maximum. Each Mystery has exactly one Prophecy Trigger. During a real encounter, your Prophecy Trigger can restore at most 1 RC per round and never above maximum. Trivial enemies, willing staged targets, summoned sacrifices, repeated corpse abuse, copied damage, copied healing and events generated solely to trigger recovery do not qualify.

A single event can satisfy only one Prophecy Trigger recovery for you even if several descriptions could apply. A Revelation repeated or copied by another feature does not independently trigger Prophecy recovery unless that feature explicitly says it counts as a new Revelation use. Restored charges never recursively trigger another recovery.

At Oracle level 11, the preserved registry draft additionally sets your starting RC when a real encounter begins to at least max(3, your Charisma modifier), capped by your current RC maximum. If you already have more RC, keep the higher current value. This encounter-start floor occurs once per encounter and cannot be triggered by staged initiative.

REVELATIONS are divine class techniques, not ordinary spells. Unless a Revelation explicitly says otherwise, magical silence does not prevent a purely mental Revelation, but a Revelation requiring speech, touch, visible symbolism or another listed component obeys that requirement. Revelations do not generate Dissonance and cannot be modified by spell-slot, RP, spell-rank discount or ordinary spell-proc mechanics.

One concentration effect may be maintained at a time unless a specific Oracle feature explicitly creates a narrow exception. Damage uses the current Core Systems concentration procedure; if half-damage rounding is required in this pilot, round down. Sustained Revelation control effects grant repeat saves at the cadence printed on the Revelation.

HARD CONTROL GUARD. A creature can suffer at most one Oracle-caused full-turn denial such as Stunned, Paralyzed, Incapacitated by control, or loss of its full Action from your Oracle features per encounter. After that succeeds once, later Oracle effects from you that would fully deny its turn instead remove its Reaction and reduce its Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn after the required save fails.

ADDITIONAL ACTION GUARD. All sources share a maximum of one additional full Action per creature per round. An additional Action cannot grant another additional Action, Bonus Action or Reaction. Features that say a creature acts out of turn use this same cap. Movement-only grants do not count as additional full Actions.

Healing from Oracle features cannot exceed maximum HP, resurrect the dead or remove Wounds unless a feature explicitly says so. Temporary HP never stack. Encounter-only regeneration and drain cannot be farmed outside meaningful combat. Corpse effects create no XP, loot, RC or repeatable corpse resources unless expressly stated.

Copied, echoed, repeated or redirected damage/healing uses only the explicitly copied numeric component. It cannot repeat RC recovery, Prophecy Triggers, action grants, conditions, passive triggers, resource restoration or another copy effect unless the copying feature explicitly says otherwise.

BASE PROGRESSION. At Oracle 1 choose Mystery and Curse; gain the RC engine, Channel Revelation, Prophetic Insight and Divine Sense. At Oracle 2 gain Curse Manifestation, Oracular Trance and Oracle's Burden. No Base feature-selection currency or Skill Points are used.

ARCH-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 3: choose one Tier I Revelation from your Mystery and automatically gain Curse Boon I. Oracle 4: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 5: automatically gain Curse Boon II; any Mystery-specific level-5 feature recorded by the registry belongs to the Mystery module below and does not create an additional generic feature here. Oracle 6: choose one Tier II Revelation and gain Mystery Surge. Oracle 8: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 9: gain your Mystery's fixed Tier III Revelation.

HERO-STAGE PROGRESSION. Oracle 10: gain Curse Boon III and Grand Revelation Foreshadow. Oracle 11: RC cap reaches 7 and the preserved encounter-start RC floor becomes active. Oracle 12: gain the Mystery-specific Mystic Insight. Oracle 13: preserved registry draft grants a second Tier II Revelation; after each completed short rest choose which of your two Tier II Revelations is Attuned for features that specifically refer to an active Tier II option, though both remain known and usable. Oracle 14: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 15: gain Revelation Mastery and Curse Boon IV. Oracle 16: preserved Prophecy Trigger Mastery. Oracle 17: preserved Grand Revelation Foreshadow upgrade. Oracle 18: Prophetic Surge. Oracle 19: separate ASI or eligible feat. Oracle 20: gain the Mystery's Final Revelation and Curse Boon V.

REVELATION MASTERY at level 15 never grants a Revelation you do not know. Choose one mastery enhancement explicitly listed by your Mystery for a Revelation you know. If a listed mastery names a Revelation you did not select, that mastery option is unavailable. Mastery cannot reduce RC below 0, create additional Actions beyond the shared cap or remove repeat-save requirements unless its exact Mystery text says so.

PROPHECY AND DIVINATION never force player beliefs, future choices or confessions. Information features can provide truthful clues, likely outcomes, symbolic visions or current facts, but the Director is not required to reveal unknowable future player decisions. Effects that command or compel a player-controlled character preserve the player's choice of targets and prohibit self-harm, permanent allegiance changes and belief alteration.

CURSE MANIFESTATION provides a common operational intensification rather than ten different hidden sub-engines. When activated, your Curse becomes visibly or metaphysically dominant for 3 rounds: gain +1 on Revelation attacks and +1 to Revelation save DC, but take -1 AC and -1 on your own saving throws for the duration. Any Curse limitation that can normally be voluntarily suppressed cannot be suppressed during Manifestation.

CURSE BOONS are automatic at Oracle levels 3, 5, 10, 15 and 20 for your ONE selected Curse. You do not choose between Curse Boons and do not gain Boons from unselected Curses. Each Curse card below operationalizes all five Boon gates and its permanent limitations.

All class gates use Oracle class level, not total character level. Normal proficiency bonus follows the game's ordinary total-character-level rule. Non-Oracle levels do not raise RC maximum, unlock Curse Boons, Revelations, Mystic Insight, Revelation Mastery, Prophetic Surge or Final Revelation.

INTEGRATION PRECEDENCE. The source ceiling draft conflicts with the registry on short rests and extra Revelation activations. This pilot explicitly chooses 1 RC on a completed short rest and permits a second Revelation only through an expressly granted extra Action or double-cast feature, never more than two Revelation resolutions per round. The preserved ceiling alternative is no short-rest recovery and one activation per round; do not combine both configurations.

All combat-triggered RC refunds, including Prophecy, damage riders and Curse Boons, share ONE recovered RC per round. Rest recovery, encounter-start floor and explicitly limited Final refills are separate. A free, copied or refunded use cannot recursively trigger another recovery. Apply this global cap even if an individual card says its recovery is separate.

The shared Prophetic Surge and your Mystery-specific level-18 Prophecy are two descriptions/options of ONE long-rest use, not two charges. Framework cards such as Tier III, Mystic Insight, Mastery and Final Revelation unlock the named Mystery card and never grant duplicate uses. A level-5 registry Mystery label grants no extra unnamed ability.

Oracle zone default: choose at most three allies and three enemies for each pulse or aura benefit, fixed at activation unless the card names fewer. Persistent damaging/healing zones require concentration and at most three pulses. Pay 1 RC before each pulse after the first, or end the effect; once-per-long-rest Finals include their printed pulses in that limited use. One pulse can affect a creature only once per round. Passive personal resistance and a single-target temporary buff are not zones.

Revelation backlash is the local one-turn penalty of -1 to attacks and saves and -5 feet Speed, ending at the end of your next turn. It is not a level of the general Exhaustion condition. Wound Eater's missed-feeding Exhaustion remains the general condition.

Initiative adjustments change order beginning next round. They never produce or erase a regular turn in the current round; a creature still gets at most one regular turn each round. Ties use the original initiative order. Fixed encounter-start bonuses do not retroactively reorder an encounter.

Extra attacks and echoed damage use base weapon/spell dice before critical-hit extra dice. A redirected damage event cannot be reduced a second time, reflected again or generate RC. Charmed alone does not grant command of a creature's actions.

Oracle’s exceptional ASI/feat schedule is 4, 8, 14 and 19. It does not gain extra ASIs at 12 or 16 from the generic class schedule. The rejected five-milestone draft remains in superseded Playtest Overrides for traceability.
workedExample: Oracle 5 example: Charisma 16 gives M=3, PB=3 and S=2. The Oracle has maximum RC 4 under the pilot schedule, begins a real encounter at RC 4, selected Spiral-Touched as the Curse, and knows one Tier I Revelation costing 1 RC.
Turn 1: use the known Tier I Revelation for 1 RC, so RC 4→3. Suppose its Mystery Prophecy Trigger does not occur. Because Revelations use RC only, no RP, spell slot, Burn or Dissonance value changes.

Turn 2: use Curse Manifestation as a Bonus Action for 1 RC, RC 3→2. For 3 rounds the Oracle gains +1 to Revelation attacks and save DC but suffers -1 AC and -1 on its own saving throws. The permanent Spiral-Touched limitations continue.

Enemy turn: the Oracle fails a saving throw. Spiral-Touched Curse Boon I is already unlocked at Oracle 3, so once per long rest the Oracle rerolls that failed save and uses the new result. This reroll costs no RC.

Turn 3: Spiral-Touched Curse Boon II is unlocked at Oracle 5. Spend 1 RC to take its once-per-combat out-of-turn Action after another creature finishes its turn, RC 2→1. This uses the universal one-additional-full-Action-per-round allowance and cannot generate another extra Action.
After combat, a completed short rest restores 1 RC, RC 1→2. A long rest would instead restore the Oracle to the current maximum of 4. Neither rest removes the Spiral-Touched Curse.
balanceQuestions: Does the provisional RC cap schedule 3→4→5→6→7, combined with short-rest recovery, Prophecy Triggers and the level-11 encounter-start floor, sustain Revelations without making charge management irrelevant?

Do Curse limitations remain meaningful after their Boons accumulate, especially for Spiral-Touched, Wound Eater, Shattered Mind and False Life, without producing excessive involuntary turn loss or noninteractive penalties?
Do the shared hard-control and additional-Action caps adequately contain Time, Tongues, Shattered Mind and other future Mystery interactions while preserving each Curse's identity?

value.description: Spend 2 charges: you and up to 2 allies within 4 tiles enter a lucid dream-state for 1 round — each may reposition up to 2 tiles without provoking and gains concealment until they act; when the dream ends, the first enemy each dreamer strikes deals +25% psychic damage as the Veiled Threshold bleeds waking into nightmare.

cards.name: Nightmare Lash
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save, taking 2d8+M psychic damage on failure or half on success. On failure it also suffers Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and no Reactions until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save then; failure extends the attack/save penalty one final round, but Reaction loss lasts only the first round. If the target was already Frightened or suffering Dread before the cast, add one extra d8 psychic damage and, after resolution, regain 1 RC at most once per round.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Nightmare Lash
value.description: Spend 2 charges: lash one enemy within 5 tiles with waking nightmare — 2d8 + Charisma modifier psychic damage; on failed save, target suffers Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 2 turns and cannot take reactions for 1 round; the Veiled Threshold shows you their dread — if they were already suffering Dread or fear, the lash deals +50% damage and you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

cards.name: Unreality
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; attacker within normal attack range
cards.frequency: Passive avoidance once per round; vanish 1/short rest
cards.effect: Once per round when an enemy attack roll would hit you, roll d4; on 4 the attack instead hits an illusory echo and misses. Separately, once per short rest when an attack would deal damage to you, use your Reaction before damage to make that attack miss and teleport to an unoccupied space 1 tile away that you can perceive. The attacker then makes a Wisdom save; on failure it suffers Dread (-1 attack and save) until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Unreality
value.description: Passive: when an enemy misses you with an attack, 25% chance they strike an illusory echo instead (once per round). Once per short rest, when you would take damage from an attack, you may instead vanish into unreality — the attack misses, you reappear 1 tile away, and the attacker must save or suffer Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 1 turn.

cards.name: Threshold Collapse
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, enemies in the aura take -1 on attack rolls and cannot gain advantage solely from flanking. Allies in the aura gain +1 on saves against Charm and Fear. Once per round at the start of one enemy's turn in the aura, choose that enemy; it makes a Wisdom save. On failure choose one ally in the aura: that enemy treats the chosen ally as visually absent until the start of its next turn and cannot target that ally with attacks requiring sight, though area effects remain legal. When a hostile creature makes the first save to disbelieve one of your Dream illusions inside the aura, success requires a second Wisdom save; failing either means it remains deceived for that illusion's normal duration.

value.name: Threshold Collapse
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, enemies within 4 tiles suffer −10% hit chance and cannot benefit from flanking — allies within the zone gain +10% saves vs charm and fear; reality frays at the edges: once per round an enemy inside must save or believe an ally is absent (attacks vs that ally have disadvantage until disproven), and your illusions inside the zone require a second save to disbelieve.

cards.name: Lucid Oracle
cards.effect: Gain advantage on saves against magical sleep and Illusion effects. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes asking the Veiled Threshold one specific question concerning the present situation or a contemplated course of action. Receive one truthful symbolic vision or omen. It cannot reveal another player's unknowable future choice.

value.name: Lucid Oracle
value.description: Advantage on saves vs sleep and illusion. Once per day, ask the Veiled Threshold one question — receive a symbolic but truthful vision.

cards.name: Dream Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Mirage: create two duplicates; each can absorb one failed-targeting attack and both share the same 2-round duration. Enhanced Shared Dream: affect up to 3 allies plus yourself. Enhanced Threshold Collapse: enemies inside the aura cannot take Reactions while they are currently deceived by one of your Dream illusions or while suffering Dread from you.

value: Enhanced Mirage: creates 2 duplicates

cards.name: Dream Prophecy

cards.effect: Activate one known Dream Revelation for 0 RC. After it resolves, become Invisible until you attack, deal damage, force a saving throw or the end of your next regular turn. During the same interval, when a creature succeeds on its first save to disbelieve one illusion you create, require a second Wisdom save; it must succeed on both to disbelieve.

value.name: Dream Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the Veiled Threshold parts — cast any Dream Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, all illusions you create require a second save to disbelieve, and enemies who fail their first save against your illusions suffer −10% hit until end of next turn.

cards.name: The Waking Lie
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 4 contiguous tiles within 6 tiles
cards.effect: Designate up to 4 contiguous tiles as dream-space for 3 rounds. Allies in those tiles have concealment. When an enemy first tries each round to directly target an ally in dream-space using sight, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure that ally appears absent and cannot be the target of that specific attack or sight-dependent effect, though the enemy may choose another legal target or use an area effect. On success it perceives normally for that attempt. When the dream-space ends, enemies currently inside make Wisdom saves, taking 3 S d6 psychic damage on failure or half on success. This cannot erase terrain, creatures, memory, ownership or objective reality.

value.name: The Waking Lie
value.description: Once per day, rewrite one battlefield truth for 3 rounds: designate up to 4 tiles as 'dream' — enemies treat allies there as absent; allies gain concealment. Reality reasserts painfully when it ends (enemies save or take psychic damage).

cards.name: Flame Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When one of your Revelations restores HP to a living ally or deals fire damage to a meaningful hostile creature, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. One Revelation use can restore at most 1 RC even if it both heals and burns or affects multiple targets.

cards.name: Ember Mantle
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; allies within 2 tiles during ignition
cards.effect: Gain fire resistance and add S HP to the first external healing effect that restores HP to you each round. Once per long rest ignite the Mantle for 2 rounds. Once per round when a creature within melee reach damages you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 fire damage. You shed bright light in 2 tiles, and allies there gain +1 on saves against Frightened.

value.name: Ember Mantle
value.description: Passive: resistance to fire damage and +5% healing received. Once per long rest, ignite your ember mantle for 2 rounds — melee attackers take 1d4 fire damage on hit, you emit warm light in a 2-tile radius, and allies there gain +5% saves vs fear.

cards.name: Wrathful Brand
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Brand at a time
cards.effect: Mark one enemy. The next damaging attack you hit it with before the Brand ends adds fire damage equal to half that attack's unmodified rolled base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. If an ally damages the marked target before the Brand ends, that ally regains 1d6 HP once per Brand and the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

value.name: Wrathful Brand
value.description: Spend 1 charge: mark one enemy with burning judgment for 1 round — your next attack against them deals +50% fire damage; if an ally attacks the marked target before the brand fades, they heal 1d6 and the target must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next round as cursed embers cling.

cards.name: Purging Flame
cards.duration: Instantaneous; attack penalty until end of undead target's next turn
cards.effect: If the target is a living ally, it regains 1d8+M HP and may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one saving throw against a disease that normally permits saves. This removes no Wounds. If the target is undead, make a Revelation attack; on hit it takes 1d8+M fire damage and makes a Constitution save, suffering -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn on failure.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Purging Flame
value.description: Spend 1 charge: touch one ally within 1 tile to end one disease or poison and heal 1d8 + your Charisma modifier; undead touched instead take equal fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit for 1 round as cursed ash clings.

cards.name: Passion's Rush
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; move up to 3 tiles in a straight or bending legal path
cards.duration: Movement instantaneous; ally buff until start of your next turn
cards.effect: Move up to 3 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks. Each meaningful hostile creature whose space you pass adjacent to can be affected once and makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 fire damage on failure or half on success; a failed target also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If you finish adjacent to an ally, that ally adds S damage to its next weapon hit and reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Passion's Rush
value.description: Spend 1 charge: blaze up to 3 tiles in a line of harmless fire — enemies passed take 1d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −1 movement until your next turn; if you end adjacent to an ally, they gain +10% weapon damage and +5% DR for 1 round as embers cling to their weapons.

cards.name: Crown's Burn

cards.duration: Damage/healing instantaneous; penalties until end of next turn
cards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6+M fire damage on failure or half on success. A failing enemy also has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Each healed ally reduces the first fire damage it takes before your next turn by S.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Crown's Burn

cards.name: Undying Ember
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies adjacent to you; allies within 2 tiles
cards.duration: Instantaneous; enemy penalty until end of next turn
cards.effect: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP. Up to three living allies within 2 tiles each regain 1d6 HP. This removes no Wounds and cannot trigger from self-inflicted staged damage.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Undying Ember
value.description: Passive: when reduced to 0 HP, erupt in shard-fire — adjacent enemies take 2d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit for 1 round; you stabilize at 1 HP (once per long rest). Allies within 2 tiles heal 1d6 as embers scatter from the Crown's mercy.

cards.name: First Flame Convergence
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your turns when a Flame Revelation deals fire damage, add one extra die matching that Revelation's primary damage die to one damage roll. Once per turn when one of your Flame Revelations damages a meaningful hostile creature, one living ally within 4 tiles regains 1d6 HP. Allies within 4 tiles are immune to Frightened. Once per turn when this effect heals an ally, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. Zealot's Renewal deals no backlash while Convergence lasts.

value.name: First Flame Convergence
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, your fire Revelations deal +25% damage and allies within 4 tiles heal 1d6 when you burn an enemy — you emit warm light and allies are immune to fear; the Crown's memory kindles: once per turn when you heal via wrathful fire, one ally within 4 tiles gains +5% DR until start of your next turn, and Zealot's Renewal backlash is suppressed during the convergence.

cards.name: Founder's Memory
cards.effect: Gain advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar, the Crown of First Flame and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per long rest after failing a saving throw against fire damage or Frightened, reroll that save and use the new result.

value.name: Founder's Memory
value.description: Advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per day, invoke the Crown's memory to reroll a failed save vs fire or fear.

Enhanced First Flame Convergence: Zealot's Renewal backlash remains suppressed for the full Convergence duration; if already suppressed by the base effect, additionally one ally healed by Zealot's Renewal during Convergence gains S temporary HP.

value.name: Flame Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the Crown of First Flame kindles through you — cast any Flame Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, your next wrathful heal this encounter deals no backlash and allies within 4 tiles gain +5% DR vs fire; burning enemies you hit take +10% fire damage until end of next turn.

cards.name: Crown Restored
cards.effect: Manifest the Crown for 3 rounds. Once on each of your turns add 2 fire damage to one damaging attack or Revelation. At the start of each living ally's turn within 5 tiles, including yours, that ally regains 1d6 HP, at most three pulses per creature from this Final and never above maximum HP. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Flame Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. Free Revelations cannot recursively restore additional RC beyond the normal once-per-round Prophecy Trigger cap.

value.name: Crown Restored
value.description: Once per day, manifest the Crown of First Flame for 3 rounds: +2 fire damage on all attacks, allies within 5 tiles regenerate 1d6 per round, and you may cast Tier I fire Revelations at 0 cost once per round.

cards.name: Life Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When you restore at least 1 actual HP to a living ally other than through a copied, reflected or staged healing event, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Healing multiple allies from one effect still restores only 1 RC that round.

originalObjects.value: When you restore HP to an ally (any source), regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

cards.name: Bloom Ward
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; allies within 2 tiles; one ally within 3 tiles for bloom
cards.duration: Passive permanent; bloom until consumed or 1 minute
cards.effect: Once per round when a living ally within 2 tiles receives HP healing from a paid or finite-use effect, add S HP to that healing. Reduce the first necrotic or poison damage you take each round by 1. Once per long rest place a protective bloom on one ally within 3 tiles. It absorbs the next 10+Oracle level damage dealt to that ally, then ends. When it ends, the ally gains +1 on saves against Frightened until the end of its next turn.

value.name: Bloom Ward
value.description: Passive: allies within 2 tiles gain +5% healing received, and you gain +5% resistance to necrotic and poison damage. Once per long rest, sprout a protective bloom on an ally within 3 tiles — absorb next 10 + level damage, then wilt and scatter petals granting +5% saves vs fear for 1 round.

cards.name: Overflowing Light
cards.effect: The target regains 2d6+M HP. Healing exceeding its maximum becomes temporary HP, maximum 10, lasting 2 rounds. When those temporary HP expire naturally, if at least 1 remains the target may end one of Frightened, Poisoned or Staggered. This cannot resurrect, remove Wounds or convert deliberately wasted healing into more than 10 temporary HP.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Overflowing Light
value.description: Spend 1 charge: heal one ally within 4 tiles for 2d6 + your Charisma modifier; excess healing above max HP becomes temporary HP (max 10) for 2 rounds, and if any temp HP remains when it fades the ally ends one minor condition.

cards.name: Resonant Seed
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Seed zone at a time
cards.effect: When a living ally starts its turn in the zone, it regains 1d4 HP, at most once per round and for at most three pulses from this use, and may end Frightened or Poisoned on the first pulse it receives. Undead entering or starting their turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant damage once per round and make a Strength save; on failure their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of that turn. Healing requires the paid 1 RC activation and ends after 3 rounds.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Resonant Seed
value.description: Spend 1 charge: plant a resonant seed in a 2-tile zone within 4 tiles for 3 rounds — allies starting turn there heal 1d4 and end one minor condition; undead entering or starting turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant and must save or suffer −1 movement until end of turn.

cards.name: Thorned Shelter
cards.effect: The target gains +2 AC and reduces the first damage it takes each round by S. Once per round when it receives HP healing from another finite effect, add 1 HP. The first melee attacker to damage it each round takes 1d4 piercing damage and must make a Strength save; on failure its Speed becomes 0 until the end of that current turn. This movement restriction is not a full-turn denial.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Life; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Thorned Shelter
value.description: Spend 1 charge: thorned vines erupt around one ally within 3 tiles — +2 AC, +10% DR, and +5% healing received for 2 rounds; the first melee attacker each round takes 1d4 piercing and cannot move away from the sheltered ally until end of turn.

cards.name: Garden of Restoration
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Garden at a time
cards.effect: At the start of each living ally's turn in the Garden, it regains 1d6 HP, maximum three pulses per creature from this use, and gains +1 HP the next time another finite healing effect restores HP before its next turn. The first time each ally enters or starts in a given Garden, it may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one disease save. Undead starting in the Garden take 1d6 radiant damage and make a Wisdom save; on failure they take -1 on attack rolls until the end of that turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Garden of Restoration
value.description: Spend 2 charges: bloom a 4-tile garden of restoration for 3 rounds — allies inside regenerate 1d6 at start of turn and gain +5% healing received; undead inside take 1d6 radiant at start of turn and must save or suffer −10% hit; entering the garden ends one minor poison or disease on that ally (once each per garden).

cards.name: Life Linked
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing living ally within 5 tiles
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Life Link at a time
cards.effect: Link yourself to the ally. Once per round when it takes damage, you may use your Reaction to transfer up to half that actual damage rounded down to yourself. Transferred damage keeps its type and cannot be redirected again. The ally reduces the first necrotic damage it takes each round by S. Once per round when one of your paid or finite Oracle effects restores HP to the linked ally, it regains an additional 1d4 HP. The link ends if you are more than 5 tiles apart. Apply mitigation to the original damage once before splitting. The transferred portion cannot be mitigated again and cannot generate recovery or retaliation triggers.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Life Linked
value.description: Spend 2 charges: link yourself to one ally within 5 tiles for 2 rounds through the Verdant Resonance — you may transfer up to half damage they take to yourself (after DR); while linked, they gain +5% healing received and +10% DR vs necrotic, and when you heal them through the link they heal an additional 1d4 as blooms echo between you.

cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies you heal; emergency ally within 4 tiles
cards.duration: Buff until end of ally's next turn; emergency instantaneous

cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Life; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Verdant Pulse
value.description: Passive: when you heal an ally below 50% HP, they gain +10% resistances and +5% healing received until end of next turn (once per ally per short rest). cards.name: Song of Mending
cards.effect: On activation and at the start of your next regular turn, each living ally still within 5 tiles regains 2d6 HP, for exactly two possible pulses per use. Once during the duration for each ally, when one damage event would reduce it below 1 HP without instant death, it remains at 1 HP instead. When this prevention triggers, that ally may end Frightened or Poisoned and gains +S HP the next time a separate finite healing effect restores HP before Song ends. value.name: Song of Mending
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, all allies within 5 tiles regenerate 2d6 at start of turn and cannot be reduced below 1 HP by a single hit (once each) — the Verdant Resonance sings through them; when an ally is stabilized by this song, they end one minor condition and gain +10% healing received until the song ends.

value.name: Bloom Oracle
value.description: Advantage on Medicine and Nature. Once per day, diagnose any affliction by touch and learn one countermeasure the Verdant Resonance suggests.

Enhanced Song of Mending: duration becomes 3 rounds and gains one additional 2d6 healing pulse at the start of your second later regular turn; each ally still receives only one 1-HP death prevention per use.
